title: SpinControl: Control Software for Prototyping and Benchmarking of Spin-Qubit Devices and Measurement Protocols
abstract: arXiv:2610.23316v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum computers require software to control the states of the qubits. As the actions on qubits grow in complexity with circuit execution, calibration, and benchmarking, the complexity of the control software grows in tandem. Spin-qubit quantum computers are at a stage where experimentalists need low-level access for tuning and calibration, and quantum algorithm researchers want high-level circuit-level access. In this article, we present the software design of SpinControl. SpinControl integrates three architectural metrics: 1) customizability, to allow prototyping devices and measurement protocols, is achieved by separating data and behaviour; 2) modularity and extensibility are achieved by separating functionalities into different components; and 3) robustness, to reliably execute quantum circuits on many qubits, is achieved by CI pipelines and input validation. translated_title: SpinControl：用于自旋量子比特器件与测量协议原型设计和基准测试的控制软件
translated_abstract: 量子计算机需要软件来控制量子比特的状态。随着对量子比特的操作在电路执行、校准和基准测试方面的复杂性不断增加，控制软件的复杂性也随之增长。自旋量子比特量子计算机正处于这样一个阶段：实验人员需要低级别的访问权限来进行调谐和校准，而量子算法研究人员则需要高级别的电路级访问。在本文中，我们介绍了SpinControl的软件设计。SpinControl融合了三项架构指标：1) 可定制性，通过分离数据与行为来实现，以支持器件和测量协议的原型设计；2) 模块化和可扩展性，通过将功能分离到不同的组件中来实现；3) 健壮性，通过CI流水线和输入验证来实现，以便在多个量子比特上可靠地执行量子电路。SpinControl支持不同类型的测量，同时支持自定义……
tldr: 本文提出了自旋量子比特控制软件SpinControl的架构设计，通过数据与行为分离、功能模块化以及CI流水线与输入验证三大指标，同时满足实验者低层调校与算法研究者高层电路访问的需求，支持器件原型设计与测量协议基准测试。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the software design of SpinControl, a control software for spin-qubit devices that achieves customizability, modularity/extensibility, and robustness through data-behavior separation, functional modularity, and CI pipelines with input validation, serving both low-level experimental tuning and high-level circuit execution needs.
